# Oyange Photography

> Aquila Oyange is a travel and portrait photographer and photo editor based in Nairobi, Kenya. He photographs portraits, graduations, couples, events, products, and hikes and safaris, and describes his approach as impact storytelling.

Website: https://oyange-photography.vercel.app
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/oyange_/
Links: https://linktr.ee/0yange
Location: Nairobi, Kenya. Travels for hikes, safaris and other shoots.
Booking: WhatsApp +254 717 393 576, or the contact form on the website.

## Packages (starting prices)

- Outdoors: from KShs 5,000. 2-hour session, 20 edited photos, online gallery.
- Events: from KShs 6,000. Coverage of your event, online gallery.
- Hikes & Safaris: from KShs 12,000. One full day, unlimited photos, edited photos, short reel, online gallery.

## What he photographs

- Portraits: studio and outdoor, professional and personal.
- Graduation: campus portraits in cap and gown, family photos.
- Couples: relaxed outdoor sessions.
- Events: launches, conferences, panels, performances.
- Product: product photos for shops and social media.
- Hikes & Safaris: full-day coverage of hiking and travel groups, including the Aberdares.
